insights.mega: IMF GFSR Oct 2026: AI-crash + yield spike + slowdown stress puts 22% of global banking assets in 110 weak banks (up from 18%), Asian banks hardest hit ex-China. Japan mega banks ordinary deposits remain ~0.400% mid-Oct, set to 0.5% from Nov 2 (highest since ~1992).
insights.flow: North Tohoku regional banks (Procrea HD/Aomori Michinoku, Iwate Bank, Akita Bank) continue merger talks targeting Apr 2028, combined assets ~¥13.3tn amid rapid population decline; deposits continue shifting toward mega and net banks under rate competition.
insights.gap: Japan household financial assets peaked ~¥2519tn (end-Jun 2026). Asset Gini rising overall and highest among youth (~0.72 for 18-24); large average-median gaps (e.g. 30s households median ¥3.11m vs average ¥10.96m) widen regional and generational divides.

Live origin remains https://ubi-chain.github.io. Intended custom www.ietfubi.com unregistered as of 2026-09-24; ubi-chain.com NXDOMAIN. Do not buy domains. Do not call Vercel purchase.
insights.ethics: Ethics of insolvency and dignity: IMF weak-bank scenarios and regional deposit outflows amplify need for redistribution. Condition-free basic income preserves dignity against rate/AI shocks rather than market-only outcomes.
insights.heal: Heal: UBI-style stable income buffers household pressure from regional fund thinning, bank consolidation, and AI-related risks, supporting recovery of local circulation and intergenerational resilience.

news.title: IMF stress test: 22% of global banking assets in weak banks under AI-crash scenario
news.summary: IMF GFSR (Oct 2026): AI crash + soaring yields + slowdown would leave 22% of global banking assets in 110 weak lenders (core capital <7%), up from 18% a year earlier. Asian banks (ex-China) most affected.

news.title: North Tohoku 3 banks advance merger talks for 2028; household assets at record
news.summary: Procrea/Iwate/Akita continue talks for Apr 2028 integration (~¥13.3tn assets) driven by demographics. Japan household financial assets ~¥2519tn peak; youth asset Gini highest.
